scripts.build:wasm:web: rm -rf crates/blake3_wasm/pkg/web && RUSTFLAGS='-C opt-level=s -C target-feature=+simd128' wasm-pack build crates/blake3_wasm --scope fuzdev --target web --release --out-dir pkg/web && deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/patch_npm_package.ts crates/blake3_wasm/pkg/web

scripts.clean: cargo clean && rm -rf crates/blake3_wasm/pkg crates/blake3_wasm_small/pkg pkg && rm -rf benches/results

scripts.compare: npm run compare:wasm && npm run compare:small && npm run compare:component

scripts.bench:wasmtime: npm run build:component && npm run bench:wasmtime:run
